snippet.title: The FIRST EVER Dragon Ball video game - Dragon Ball: Pilaf no Gyakushū (1986)
snippet.description:
The first Dragon Ball video game ever, published by Epoch in 1986. Info on this elusive handheld is sparse, so I'm happy to have tracked down a working copy and record footage of the game.

The MODE button switches between the clock, demo mode, and gameplay mode. The only difference I could find between Game 1 and Game 2 is that in the latter you have to press the MODE/ACTION button to attack enemies/save Roshi, whereas in the former, these things happen automatically when you are positioned correctly.

The planes get faster the longer you play. Game Over happens either after taking five hits from Pilaf's planes or failing to catch Roshi three times.
